claims.text: Over the 7 days from the patch, the positive share was -5.2 points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch (90% range -79.7 to +69.4). That isn't enough to credit the patch: its 90% range includes no change at all.
Negative reviews mentioning content issues fell by 9.75 percentage points compared to the baseline.
Reviews from players with over 200 hours of playtime made up 30.87% of reviews in the window.

report.summary: Over the 7 days from the patch, the positive share fell by 5.18 percentage points against the estimate without it, which is not enough to credit the patch. Negative reviews mentioning content issues fell by 9.75 percentage points compared to the baseline, and reviews from players with over 200 hours of playtime made up 30.87% of reviews in the window. The patch, a price change or sale, and a change in who reviewed are inconclusive, while off-topic reviews or a review bomb and noise or seasonality are ruled out.
